    50→
    51→  /** Compute run counts by project for the sidebar */
    52→  const runsByProject = useMemo(() => {
    53→    const map = new Map<number, { running: number; total: number }>();
    54→    for (const card of agentRunCards) {
    55→      const pid = card.project.id;
    56→      const existing = map.get(pid) ?? { running: 0, total: 0 };
    57→      existing.total++;

    59→      map.set(pid, existing);

   423→            zIndex: 100,
   424→          }}
   425→        >
   426→          <div onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()} style={{ width: '100%', maxWidth: '500px' }}>
   427→            <ProjectSetup
   428→              projects={projects}
   429→              onSelect={handleProjectSelect}
   430→              onCreate={handleProjectCreate}
   431→              onClone={handleCloneProject}
   432→            />
   433→          </div>
   434→        </div>
   435→      )}
   436→    </div>
   437→  );
   438→}
   439→
   440→function App() {
   441→  const wsUrl = `${window.location.protocol === 'https:' ? 'wss:' : 'ws:'}//${window.location.host}/ws`;
   442→  return (
   443→    <WebSocketProvider url={wsUrl}>
   444→      <MissionControl />
   445→    </WebSocketProvider>
   446→  );
   447→}
   448→
   449→export default App;

    25→/** Format seconds into HH:MM:SS */
    26→function formatUptime(seconds: number): string {

    30→  return `${String(h).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(m).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(s).padStart(2, '0')}`;

AI-powered development orchestrator

Usage: forge [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  init       Initialize a new forge project
  interview  Conduct an interactive interview to generate a project spec
  generate   Generate implementation phases from the project spec
  run        
  phase      
  list       
  status     
  reset      
  audit      
  learn      Learn a pattern from the current project
  patterns   List or show learned patterns
  config     View or validate configuration
  skills     Manage skills (reusable prompt fragments)
  compact    Manually trigger context compaction for a phase
  implement  Implement a design document end-to-end with TDD phases
  factory    Launch the Code Factory Kanban UI
  swarm      Execute phases in parallel using DAG scheduling with optional reviews
  help       Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -v, --verbose
          
      --yes
          
      --auto-approve-threshold <AUTO_APPROVE_THRESHOLD>
          [default: 5]
      --project-dir <PROJECT_DIR>
          
      --spec-file <SPEC_FILE>
          Path to the spec file. If not provided, will search for *spec*.md files in docs/plans/
      --context-limit <CONTEXT_LIMIT>
          Context limit for compaction (e.g., "80%" or "500000" chars). Overrides forge.toml setting
      --autonomous
          Enable autonomous mode for this run (overrides forge.toml)
  -h, --help
          Print help
  -V, --version

     1→const BASE_URL = '/api';
     2→
     3→async function request<T>(path: string, options?: RequestInit): Promise<T> {
     4→  const res = await fetch(`${BASE_URL}${path}`, {
     5→    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...options?.headers },
     6→    ...options,
     7→  });
     8→  if (!res.ok) {
     9→    const error = await res.text();
    10→    throw new Error(`API error ${res.status}: ${error}`);
    11→  }
    12→  if (res.status === 204) return undefined as T;
    13→  return res.json();
    14→}
    15→
    16→export const api = {
    17→  // Projects
    18→  listProjects: () => request<import('../types').Project[]>('/projects'),
    19→  createProject: (name: string, path: string) =>
    20→    request<import('../types').Project>('/projects', {
    21→      method: 'POST',
    22→      body: JSON.stringify({ name, path }),
    23→    }),
    24→  cloneProject: (repoUrl: string) =>
    25→    request<import('../types').Project>('/projects/clone', {
    26→      method: 'POST',
    27→      body: JSON.stringify({ repo_url: repoUrl }),
    28→    }),
    29→  getProject: (id: number) => request<import('../types').Project>(`/projects/${id}`),
    30→  deleteProject: (id: number) =>
    31→    request<void>(`/projects/${id}`, { method: 'DELETE' }),
    32→
    33→  // Board
    34→  getBoard: (projectId: number) =>
    35→    request<import('../types').BoardView>(`/projects/${projectId}/board`),
    36→
    37→  // Issues

    39→    request<import('../types').Issue>(`/projects/${projectId}/issues`, {
    40→      method: 'POST',
    41→      body: JSON.stringify({ title, description, column }),

    43→  getIssue: (id: number) => request<import('../types').IssueDetail>(`/issues/${id}`),

Got it — subcommands + global options, and we'll use Forge itself to manage the work by creating issues in the factory and executing them. Let me propose approaches.

## Approaches

### A. Static hardcoded list (Recommended)
Define the commands and options as a constant array in the frontend. Simple, no backend changes needed.
- **Pros**: Zero latency, no API calls, easy to maintain
- **Cons**: Must update manually when CLI changes

### B. Backend `/api/cli-help` endpoint
Parse `forge --help` output on the server and expose via API.
- **Pros**: Always in sync with the binary
- **Cons**: Needs a new API endpoint, adds backend complexity for a cosmetic feature

### C. JSON schema generated at build time
Run `forge --help` during build, generate a JSON file bundled with the UI.
- **Pros**: Always in sync, no runtime cost
- **Cons**: Build pipeline complexity

**I recommend A** — the CLI commands rarely change, and this is cosmetic. A static list gets us there fastest. We can upgrade to B later if needed.

## Design

**Component: `CommandAutocomplete`** — replaces the raw `<input>` in StatusBar.

- **Data**: Static array of `{ value: string, type: 'command' | 'option', description: string }`
- **Dropdown**: Filtered list below input, keyboard navigable (Arrow Up/Down, Enter to select, Escape to close)
- **Ghost text**: Top match shown as faded text after cursor, Tab to accept
- **Trigger**: Dropdown opens on focus or typing; filters as user types
- **Styling**: Matches existing dark terminal aesthetic (var(--color-*) tokens)

No backend changes. No new files beyond the component. The `StatusBar` swaps the `<input>` for `<CommandAutocomplete>`.

**Does this design look good?** If so, I'll write the design doc, create issues in Forge, and dispatch the agent team.

> AGENT

Smart — building the plumbing now saves rework later. Revised design:

## Design

### Backend: `GET /api/cli-help`
- New endpoint in `src/factory/api.rs`
- Runs `forge --help` (using `FORGE_CMD` env var), parses the output
- Returns JSON: `{ commands: [{ name, description }], options: [{ flag, description }] }`
- Cached in memory (CLI help doesn't change at runtime)

### Frontend: `CommandAutocomplete` component
- Fetches `/api/cli-help` once on mount, caches in state

     1→import { useState, useRef, useEffect, useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';
     2→import { api } from '../api/client';
     3→import type { CliHelpResponse } from '../types';
     4→
     5→interface CommandAutocompleteProps {
     6→  onCommand?: (command: string) => void;
     7→}
     8→
     9→interface SuggestionItem {
    10→  kind: 'cmd' | 'opt';
    11→  label: string;
    12→  description: string;
    13→}
    14→
    15→export default function CommandAutocomplete({ onCommand }: CommandAutocompleteProps) {
    16→  const [input, setInput] = useState('');
    17→  const [helpData, setHelpData] = useState<CliHelpResponse | null>(null);
    18→  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
    19→  const [highlightIndex, setHighlightIndex] = useState(0);
    20→
    21→  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
    22→  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
    23→
    24→  // Fetch CLI help data on mount
    25→  useEffect(() => {
    26→    api.cliHelp().then(setHelpData).catch(() => {});
    27→  }, []);
    28→
    29→  // Build flat suggestion list from help data
    30→  const allItems = useMemo<SuggestionItem[]>(() => {
    31→    if (!helpData) return [];
    32→    const cmds: SuggestionItem[] = helpData.commands.map(c => ({
    33→      kind: 'cmd',
    34→      label: c.name,
    35→      description: c.description,
    36→    }));
    37→    const opts: SuggestionItem[] = helpData.options.map(o => ({
    38→      kind: 'opt',
    39→      label: o.flag,
    40→      description: o.description,
    41→    }));
    42→    return [...cmds, ...opts];
    43→  }, [helpData]);
    44→
    45→  // Filter by prefix match
    46→  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    47→    if (!input) return allItems;
    48→    const lower = input.toLowerCase();
    49→    return allItems.filter(item => item.label.toLowerCase().startsWith(lower));
    50→  }, [allItems, input]);
    51→
    52→  // Ghost text: remaining chars of top match
    53→  const ghostText = useMemo(() => {
    54→    if (!input || filtered.length === 0) return '';
    55→    const top = filtered[0].label;
    56→    if (top.toLowerCase().startsWith(input.toLowerCase())) {
    57→      return top.slice(input.length);
    58→    }
    59→    return '';
    60→  }, [input, filtered]);
    61→
    62→  // Reset highlight when filtered list changes
    63→  useEffect(() => {
    64→    setHighlightIndex(0);
    65→  }, [filtered.length]);
    66→
    67→  // Click outside to close
    68→  useEffect(() => {
    69→    function handleClick(e: MouseEvent) {
    70→      if (containerRef.current && !containerRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) {
    71→        setOpen(false);
    72→      }
    73→    }
    74→    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClick);
    75→    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClick);
    76→  }, []);
    77→
    78→  const selectItem = useCallback((item: SuggestionItem) => {
    79→    setInput(item.label);
    80→    setOpen(false);
    81→    inputRef.current?.focus();
    82→  }, []);
    83→
    84→  const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    85→    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' && open) {
    86→      e.preventDefault();
    87→      setHighlightIndex(i => (i + 1) % filtered.length);
    88→    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' && open) {
    89→      e.preventDefault();
    90→      setHighlightIndex(i => (i - 1 + filtered.length) % filtered.length);
    91→    } else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
    92→      e.preventDefault();
    93→      if (open && filtered.length > 0) {
    94→        selectItem(filtered[highlightIndex]);
    95→      } else if (input.trim()) {
    96→        onCommand?.(input.trim());
    97→        setInput('');
    98→        setOpen(false);
    99→      }
   100→    } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
   101→      setOpen(false);
   102→    } else if (e.key === 'Tab' && ghostText) {
   103→      e.preventDefault();
   104→      setInput(input + ghostText);
   105→      setOpen(false);
   106→    }
   107→  };
   108→
   109→  return (
   110→    <div ref={containerRef} style={{ position: 'relative', flex: 1 }}>
   111→      {/* Input + ghost text wrapper */}
   112→      <div style={{ position: 'relative' }}>
   113→        <input
   114→          ref={inputRef}
   115→          type="text"
   116→          value={input}
   117→          onChange={e => {
   118→            setInput(e.target.value);
   119→            setOpen(true);
   120→          }}
   121→          onFocus={() => setOpen(true)}
   122→          onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
   123→          placeholder="type a command..."
   124→          style={{
   125→            width: '100%',
   126→            background: 'transparent',
   127→            border: 'none',
   128→            outline: 'none',
   129→            color: 'var(--color-text-primary)',
   130→            fontFamily: 'inherit',
   131→            fontSize: 'inherit',
   132→          }}
   133→        />
   134→        {/* Ghost text overlay */}
   135→        {ghostText && (
   136→          <span
   137→            aria-hidden
   138→            style={{
   139→              position: 'absolute',
   140→              left: 0,
   141→              top: 0,
   142→              pointerEvents: 'none',
   143→              fontFamily: 'inherit',
   144→              fontSize: 'inherit',
   145→              color: 'var(--color-text-secondary)',
   146→              opacity: 0.5,
   147→              whiteSpace: 'pre',
   148→            }}
   149→          >
   150→            <span style={{ visibility: 'hidden' }}>{input}</span>
   151→            {ghostText}
   152→          </span>
   153→        )}
   154→      </div>
   155→
   156→      {/* Dropdown */}
   157→      {open && filtered.length > 0 && (
   158→        <div
   159→          style={{
   160→            position: 'absolute',
   161→            top: '100%',
   162→            left: 0,
   163→            right: 0,
   164→            marginTop: '4px',
   165→            backgroundColor: 'var(--color-bg-card)',
   166→            border: '1px solid var(--color-border)',
   167→            borderRadius: '4px',
   168→            maxHeight: '200px',
   169→            overflowY: 'auto',
   170→            zIndex: 1000,
   171→          }}
   172→        >
   173→          {filtered.map((item, i) => (
   174→            <div
   175→              key={`${item.kind}-${item.label}`}
   176→              onMouseDown={e => {
   177→                e.preventDefault();
   178→                selectItem(item);
   179→              }}
   180→              onMouseEnter={() => setHighlightIndex(i)}
   181→              style={{
   182→                display: 'flex',
   183→                alignItems: 'center',
   184→                padding: '6px 10px',
   185→                cursor: 'pointer',
   186→                backgroundColor: i === highlightIndex ? 'var(--color-bg-card-hover)' : 'transparent',
   187→                gap: '8px',
   188→                fontSize: '13px',
   189→              }}
   190→            >
   191→              <span style={{
   192→                fontSize: '10px',
   193→                padding: '1px 4px',
   194→                borderRadius: '2px',
   195→                backgroundColor: 'var(--color-border)',
   196→                color: 'var(--color-text-secondary)',
   197→                flexShrink: 0,
   198→              }}>
   199→                {item.kind}
   200→              </span>
   201→              <span style={{ color: 'var(--color-text-primary)', flexShrink: 0 }}>
   202→                {item.label}
   203→              </span>
   204→              <span style={{
   205→                color: 'var(--color-text-secondary)',
   206→                opacity: 0.7,
   207→                overflow: 'hidden',
   208→                textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
   209→                whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
   210→                marginLeft: 'auto',
   211→              }}>
   212→                {item.description}
   213→              </span>
   214→            </div>
   215→          ))}
   216→        </div>
   217→      )}
   218→    </div>
   219→  );
   220→}

     1→/** Top status bar — system stats, command input, view toggle, uptime, WebSocket indicator. */
     2→import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
     3→import { useWsStatus } from '../contexts/WebSocketContext';
     4→import type { ViewMode } from '../types';
     5→import CommandAutocomplete from './CommandAutocomplete';
     6→
     7→/** Props for the StatusBar component */
     8→export interface StatusBarProps {
     9→  /** Counts of agent runs by status */
    10→  agentCounts: {
    11→    running: number;
    12→    queued: number;
    13→    completed: number;
    14→    failed: number;
    15→  };
    16→  /** Total number of projects loaded */
    17→  projectCount: number;
    18→  /** Callback when user submits a command via the input */
    19→  onCommand?: (command: string) => void;
    20→  /** Current view mode for the grid */
    21→  viewMode: ViewMode;
    22→  /** Callback when user toggles the view mode */
    23→  onViewModeChange: (mode: ViewMode) => void;
    24→}
    25→
    26→/** Format seconds into HH:MM:SS */
    27→function formatUptime(seconds: number): string {
    28→  const h = Math.floor(seconds / 3600);
    29→  const m = Math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60);
    30→  const s = seconds % 60;
    31→  return `${String(h).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(m).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(s).padStart(2, '0')}`;
    32→}
    33→
    34→/** Status bar displayed at the top of the Mission Control dashboard. */
    35→export default function StatusBar({
    36→  agentCounts,
    37→  projectCount,
    38→  onCommand,
    39→  viewMode,
    40→  onViewModeChange,
    41→}: StatusBarProps) {
    42→  const wsStatus = useWsStatus();
    43→  const [uptime, setUptime] = useState(0);
    44→
    45→  // Uptime counter
    46→  useEffect(() => {
    47→    const interval = setInterval(() => setUptime(u => u + 1), 1000);
    48→    return () => clearInterval(interval);
    49→  }, []);
    50→
    51→  const wsColor = wsStatus === 'connected'
    52→    ? 'var(--color-success)'
    53→    : wsStatus === 'connecting'
    54→      ? 'var(--color-warning)'
    55→      : 'var(--color-error)';
    56→
    57→  return (
    58→    <div style={{
    59→      display: 'flex',
    60→      alignItems: 'center',
    61→      height: '40px',
    62→      padding: '0 12px',
    63→      backgroundColor: 'var(--color-bg-card)',
    64→      borderBottom: '1px solid var(--color-border)',
    65→      gap: '16px',
    66→      fontSize: '13px',
    67→      flexShrink: 0,
    68→    }}>
    69→      {/* Logo */}
    70→      <span style={{ color: 'var(--color-success)', fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: '2px' }}>
    71→        FORGE
    72→      </span>
    73→
    74→      {/* System stats */}
    75→      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '12px', color: 'var(--color-text-secondary)' }}>
    76→        <span>
    77→          <span style={{ color: 'var(--color-success)' }}>{agentCounts.running}</span> running
    78→        </span>
    79→        <span>
    80→          <span style={{ color: 'var(--color-warning)' }}>{agentCounts.queued}</span> queued
    81→        </span>
    82→        <span>
    83→          <span style={{ color: 'var(--color-success)' }}>{agentCounts.completed}</span> done
    84→        </span>
    85→        <span>
    86→          <span style={{ color: 'var(--color-error)' }}>{agentCounts.failed}</span> failed
    87→        </span>
    88→        <span>{projectCount} projects</span>
    89→      </div>
    90→
    91→      {/* Command input */}
    92→      <div style={{
    93→        flex: 1,
    94→        display: 'flex',
    95→        alignItems: 'center',
    96→        maxWidth: '500px',
    97→        margin: '0 auto',
    98→      }}>
    99→        <span style={{ color: 'var(--color-accent)', marginRight: '8px' }}>forge&gt;</span>
   100→        <CommandAutocomplete onCommand={onCommand} />
   101→      </div>
   102→
   103→      {/* View toggle */}
   104→      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '4px' }}>
   105→        <button
   106→          onClick={() => onViewModeChange('grid')}
   107→          style={{
   108→            padding: '4px 8px',
   109→            background: viewMode === 'grid' ? 'var(--color-border)' : 'transparent',
   110→            border: '1px solid var(--color-border)',
   111→            color: 'var(--color-text-primary)',
   112→            cursor: 'pointer',
   113→            fontSize: '12px',
   114→          }}
   115→          title="Grid view"
